name: Hacking operations
required_outputs: Nine-panel location sheet: hero wide, north/south/east/west coverage, overhead plan with camera markers, ceiling/floor, fixed props/materials, reverse wide
Separate clean full-resolution 16:9 hero and reverse plates, without grid labels
Annotated overhead layout with fixed door/window/prop coordinates and screen axis
Lighting/material palette and day/night variants only when script needs them
Blank screens and signage areas plus separate exact typography overlays
QC record, source references, prompt, model/version, dimensions and file hash
qa_notes: Camera A is north of the worktable looking north, but hero includes that table in the foreground. That A position cannot produce the shown hero composition. Correction: Move the hero camera marker south of the worktable and state its northward bearing. Give B/C explicit position-plus-direction labels.

Second wide shows the fronts of the north-wall monitors while also presenting itself as the desk-to-south-warehouse reverse. It works as an oblique overview but is not a verified opposite-angle camera plate. Correction: Retain as an oblique overview. Derive the true southward reverse from the approved plan if the edit needs matching reverses; do not use its label alone as camera authority.
Strong usable operations design. Main counts and anchors pass; plan-camera and reverse-label corrections remain. No regeneration retry requested.
Generated sheets are review drafts, not production-approved camera or geometry masters.
Floor-plan camera B/C east/west descriptions require correction.
